Dear Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my own calendar, I have these openings:

- Monday Nov 23, 10:00-10:30
- Monday Nov 23, 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday Nov 24, 11:00-11:30
- Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00-15:30
- Friday Nov 27, 11:00-11:30

Would any of those suit you? If you'd rather name another time, I'll fit around it.

Thank you,
Priya

Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27). Slots that are free on my side, inside 09:00-17:00:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Thursday 10:00-10:30
- Thursday 14:00-14:30

Which of those works for you, or would you suggest another slot?

Dear Priya,

Thank you — Monday Nov 23, 10:00-10:30 works well for me. I've put it in my calendar.

(Of the others you offered: 14:00-14:30 Monday and both Tuesday slots were free but I only need one; Friday 11:00-11:30 collides with my paper review, so that one wouldn't have worked.)

See you Monday,
Professor Alvarez

Hi Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my calendar, I have these free slots between 09:00 and 17:00:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30
- Thursday 14:00-14:30
- Friday 11:00-11:30

Would any of these work for you? If not, tell me a time that suits you and I'll fit my schedule around it.

Thanks,
John

Dear Sarah,

Monday Nov 23, 14:00-14:30 works for me — I've booked it for our 1:1.

(Monday 10:00-10:30 is already taken that week, and Thursday 14:00-14:30 runs into my 12:50-14:20 PhD student 1:1; I don't want to cut that short.)

See you Monday,
Professor Alvarez

Hi John,

Tuesday Nov 24, 11:00-11:30 works — I've booked it for our 1:1.

(For the record: Monday 10:00-10:30 is taken, Thursday 14:00-14:30 runs into my PhD student 1:1 and the curriculum committee, and Friday 11:00-11:30 collides with my paper review.)

See you Tuesday,
Professor Alvarez

Dear Professor Alvarez,

Great — Monday Nov 23, 10:00-10:30 it is. I've put it in my calendar.

See you then,
Priya

Thank you — Monday Nov 23, 14:00-14:30 is in my calendar. See you then.

Sarah
Perfect, thank you — Tuesday Nov 24, 11:00-11:30 is in my calendar. See you then.
